faq_heading: 2 bedroom condos in Ladner: your questions answered

faq.q: How much does a 2 bedroom condo cost in Ladner?
faq.a: Of the 2 bedroom condos in Ladner, 39 sold over the past year at a median of $600,000, with the middle half between $536,000 and $652,000.

faq.q: How long does a 2 bedroom condo take to sell in Ladner?
faq.a: The median was 23 days, and homes sold for 97.1% of the list price at a median.

faq.q: Which Ladner neighbourhood has the most 2 bedroom condos sales?
faq.a: Delta Manor, with 19 of the 39 sales at a median of $537,000.

faq.q: Which buildings in Ladner have 2 bedroom condos for sale most often?
faq.a: By sales over the past year: Sunningdale (7 sales, median $535,000); Westham Lane (4 sales); Green Gables (3 sales); The Pointe (3 sales).

faq.q: What is the strata fee on a 2 bedroom condo in Ladner?
faq.a: The median strata fee on the 2 bedroom condos that sold in Ladner was $505 a month. Fees vary by building, so check the building's own figure.

blocks.text: How 2 bedroom condos in Ladner compare
A 2 bedroom condo in Ladner sold for $120,000 more at the median than a 1 bedroom one ($600,000 against $480,000, 5 sales). The strata fee was $505 a month against $375.
Of the 9 cities with 2 bedroom condo pages, Ladner has the second highest median price. Chilliwack is lowest at $383,000 and Tsawwassen highest at $614,000.
